title: Sandbox 1 island biomes
note: The island's biomes, each giving one resource and how much a batch at a dome's first level, how many biomes a hex holds, what opening a new hex takes and the ground rent. v0.4. TEN biomes, each extracting exactly ONE resource. Every hex is composed of 1 or 2 biomes; extraction requires a FACTORY dome on a hex with the matching biome. yieldPerBatch = units per extraction batch at dome LV.1. All land belongs to the CITY SPARK — hexes are rented, never sold.
